scientific_limitations: All verified solvers are 1D, periodic and dimensionless.
No cosmological expansion (comoving) terms, thermochemistry, radiative transfer, stars, galaxies, planets, or life are simulated.
Beyond shell crossing / strong nonlinearity only conservation is checked, not accuracy (energy drift reaches ~4e-3); the observatory warns when drift > 1e-3.
Positivity-recovery paths verified only by fault injection.
Error tolerances are regression guards (~1.5x measured), not independent accuracy proofs.
Pause/checkpoint is bitwise only on step boundaries (observatory enforces this).
The browser viewer has not been rendered or clicked in a real browser in this environment; only its code was executed in Node against real data.
CI workflow written but never executed; no Windows run performed.
Old physical_models.gas_step demo unchanged and unverified.
